# Admixtools

```{r}
#devtools::install_github("uqrmaie1/admixtools")
#library(admixtools)

#devtools::install_github("uqrmaie1/admixtools", dependencies = TRUE)

#no snps
bim <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/biomart/merge_full_no_relatives_LDpruned.bim"))

geno_data = resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/biomart/merge_full_no_relatives_LDpruned")

#For now won't write to disk
f2_blocks <- admixtools::f2_from_geno(geno_data)
dim(f2_blocks)
# 9     9 49183
#`f2_blocks` is now a 3d-array with $f_2$-statistics for each population pair along dimensions 1 and 2, and each SNP block along the 3rd dimension.
admixtools::count_snps(f2_blocks)

pop1 <- c("Central_Highland","East_Coast","Northern_Coast","NorthWestern_Coast","Southern_Highland")
pop2 <- c("KHM_SA")
pop3 <- c("BOR") #compared to Sumba

test <- admixtools::f3(f2_blocks, pop1, pop2, pop3)


print(test)

admixtools::count_snps(f2_blocks)
# was 659301 first go - removes 16k filtering
# now 363617



```



```{r}
#Tried an ROH analysis in PLINK - some issues but have some results

ROH.indiv <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/biomart/ROH.hom.indiv"), header = TRUE)
ROH.indiv <- as.data.frame(ROH.indiv)
fam <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/biomart/merge_full_no_relatives_LDpruned.fam"))


ggplot2::ggplot(ROH.indiv, ggplot2::aes(x = NSEG, y= KBAVG,color = fam$V1)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point() +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "ROH", x = "Number of ROHs per individual", y = "Average length of ROHs per individual")
ggplot2::ggplot(ROH.indiv, ggplot2::aes(x = NSEG, y= KB,color = fam$V1)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point() +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "ROH", x = "Number of ROHs per individual", y = "Average length of ROHs per individual")

#Weird pattern...looks like a problem with my input? 

#Same thing in malagasy only...
ggplot2::ggplot(ROH.indiv[ROH.indiv$FID==c("Central_Highland","East_Coast","Northern_Coast","NorthWestern_Coast","Southern_Highland"),], ggplot2::aes(x = NSEG, y= KBAVG,color = FID)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point() +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "ROH", x = "Number of ROHs per individual", y = "Average length of ROHs per individual")

ggplot2::ggplot(ROH.indiv[ROH.indiv$FID==c("Central_Highland","East_Coast","Northern_Coast","NorthWestern_Coast","Southern_Highland"),], ggplot2::aes(x = NSEG, y= KB,color = FID)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point() +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "ROH", x = "Number of ROHs per individual", y = "Total length of ROHs per individual")

#is it related to sex?
#SA and Sumba data has sex included in .fam but Malagasy and Borneo data doesn't

ROH.indiv$SEX <- as.factor(fam$V5)

ggplot2::ggplot(ROH.indiv, ggplot2::aes(x = NSEG, y = KB,color = SEX)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point()+
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c("0" = "grey","1"="pink","2"="green"))
#suggests maybe...?



#boxplot of total ROH 

ggplot2::ggplot(ROH.indiv, ggplot2::aes(x=FID, y = KB, fill = FID))+
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot()+
  ggplot2::labs()

ggplot2::ggplot(ROH.indiv[ROH.indiv$FID==c("Central_Highland","East_Coast","Northern_Coast","NorthWestern_Coast","Southern_Highland"),], ggplot2::aes(x=FID, y = KB, fill = FID))+
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot()+
  ggplot2::labs()

#this pretty much mirrors the Hamid et al 2023 steps (although their metric differed slightly - Central Highland had the most of their genome contained in ROH, followed by southern highland and then the west - see https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2023.11.21.568192v1.full)
#
ggplot2::ggplot(ROH.indiv[ROH.indiv$FID==c("Central_Highland","East_Coast","Northern_Coast","NorthWestern_Coast","Southern_Highland"),], ggplot2::aes(x=FID, y = NSEG, fill = FID))+
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot()+
  ggplot2::labs()

```
